verdict.rationale: Chroma is a vector database, and a data product could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only retrieval primitives (similarity search, full-text search), an MCP server that lets external agents like Claude query Chroma, and LangChain integrations for question answering. These are developer building blocks or external-agent integrations, not AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside Chroma itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
